Boolean is type of value that consists of either True or False. 


A variable can also store a Boolean. 


Create a variable call bool and set it to True.

The NOT block reverses a boolean value. That is, a True will become a False and a False will become a True.

  

Form the code and test it out.
  

You are developing a toggle switch. Pressing the switch turns it on and off alternately.

                  

Using the blocks below, form a code that behaves like the toggle switch.
